task.title: M7: codeviz export static build reading snapshots/*.json.gz
task.description:
Implement codeviz export <dir> [refs...]: build the same web UI with the static DataSource reading snapshots/*.json.gz plus an index file, copying only the selected refs' snapshots (default: every cached ref) into <dir>/snapshots/. The data folder is named snapshots, never data, because Particles skips data/. WORKTREE is refused with a clear error since it is never cached. The output must open from a static file server with no API.

Acceptance criteria:
- codeviz export out/ main v1.0.0 produces out/index.html, assets, out/snapshots/index.json, and one .json.gz per selected ref.
- The static DataSource reads the index and gzip snapshots in the browser and all views (treemap, graph, compare between exported refs) work from a plain static server.
- codeviz export out/ WORKTREE exits non-zero with an explanatory message; unknown or uncached refs are reported before anything is written.
- Export never writes outside <dir> and refuses a non-empty <dir> without --force.
- Integration test exports a scripted repo and serves it with a static server under Node 20.
